name: Production Linked Incentive Support on JDPs
benefit:
- Financial incentive reimbursing 5% of the cost of Jute Raw Material used in manufacturing exported Jute Diversified Products.
- The reimbursement is limited to 3% of the sales value of Jute Diversified Products exports, whichever is less.
- The maximum financial support provided is ₹12,00,000/- per unit per annum.

_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a Jute Mill Company or a Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise unit set up within the geographical boundary of India. - The applicant must be actively engaged in the manufacturing and export of Jute Diversified Products. - The applicant must ensure the manufactured products contain more than 50% jute content by weight, or more than 33% by weight in the case of multifibres where jute is the dominant fibre.
